## Ctrl+/ line comments across languages

- **Wider language markers**: Ctrl+/ (toggle line comment) now uses the right marker for more file types — Typst and C-family (`//`), Python / shells / YAML / TOML / Dockerfile / Makefile (`#`), CSS (`/* */`), Lua / SQL / Haskell (`--`), TeX (`%`), Lisp (`;`), Fortran (`!`), OCaml (`(* *)`), plus GraphQL, Svelte, Astro, and related extensions.
- **Path-based styles**: Extensionless names such as `Dockerfile` and `Makefile` get `#` via `comment_style_for_path`.
- **Markdown untitled**: Still uses `<!-- -->` when there is no path.
